During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supply [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was assembled at the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]], intended to support an Imperial campaign on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]]. An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] assaulted the naval force, while a ground force raided [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] for the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies.
